propositions: SSM SecureString secrets in operator-seeded terraform resources persist cleartext values in remote state via the provider's refresh operation despite ignore_changes preventing diffs
Terraform write-only arguments value_wo and value_wo_version prevent the provider from storing secrets to state by design, eliminating the cleartext exposure

Three resources (rebar_secrets, opcert_ed25519_key, cookie_signing_secret) must migrate from value+ignore_changes pattern to value_wo+value_wo_version pair, requiring terraform >= 1.11 and aws provider >= 5.79
Cutover apply will reset already-seeded secrets to placeholder CHANGEME due to version transition absent→1, requiring coordinated re-seed/rotation in a single maintenance window
Consumers asserting the old ignore_changes invariant (opcert-plan-assertions.sh, test_opcert_deploy_infra.py) must be updated to assert the new value_wo invariant
New hermetic guard script checks that every SecureString parameter uses value_wo+value_wo_version without literal values or ignore_changes, integrated into make lint
